snippet.title: PlayStation - Tasogare no Ode - Ode to the Sunset Era (1996) - Intro
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Tasogare no Ode: Ode to the Sunset Era is a Role-Playing game, published by Tonkin House, which was released in Japan in 1996.
